# The RefMod A/B/C experiment (#7, #8): a camera tour that leaves the salon and comes back to it.
# A, B and C render this same template at the same seed; only the RefMods differ (see run_sheet.md).
# The SEND: lines hand stills to Orrery Refs, which B and C turn into RefMods; they never reach the prompt.
#   images 3-6: the place, four stills of the salon from the first chunk (C)
#   images 7-9: the recent memory, three stills of the chunk before (B and C)
@h3 ref2va 16:9 0.6MP
style: live-action, architectural documentary, warm evening light, photorealistic, one continuous unbroken ten-second shot at eye level
context: 22

CAST
SALON: a double-height salon with a black-and-white checkered marble floor, a curved white staircase, a black grand piano, a green velvet sofa, a tall gilt mirror and a crystal chandelier
HALLWAY: a long hallway with dark wood panelling, a red runner rug and gold-framed portraits
LIBRARY: a two-storey library with floor-to-ceiling shelves, a rolling brass ladder and a reading desk with a green glass lamp

CHUNK the salon
SHOT 10s: arc, slow
The camera circles slowly through SALON: past the black grand piano, along the green velvet sofa and the tall gilt mirror, under the crystal chandelier, and up the sweep of the curved white staircase. Late sun falls across the checkered marble floor. At the end the camera settles on the open double doors to the hallway.
SFX: a quiet, large room; a clock ticking; distant birdsong through the windows
HANDOFF: the open double doors to the hallway fill the centre of the frame
SEND: frame 0 to image 3
SEND: frame 60 to image 4
SEND: frame 120 to image 5
SEND: frame 180 to image 6
SEND: frame 0 to image 7 for segment 1
SEND: frame 100 to image 8 for segment 1
SEND: frame 200 to image 9 for segment 1

CHUNK the hallway
SHOT 10s: push in, slow
The camera glides through the doors and along HALLWAY, over the red runner rug, past the gold-framed portraits on the dark wood panelling, toward a tall door at the far end that stands ajar.
SFX: soft footsteps on a rug; the creak of old floorboards
HANDOFF: the tall door at the end of the hallway swings open
SEND: frame 0 to image 7 for segment 2
SEND: frame 100 to image 8 for segment 2
SEND: frame 200 to image 9 for segment 2

CHUNK the library
SHOT 10s: push in, slow
The camera moves into LIBRARY, past the floor-to-ceiling shelves and the rolling brass ladder, around the reading desk with its green glass lamp, toward a second pair of doors on the far side, which open back onto the salon.
SFX: the hush of a library; a page turning somewhere; the lamp's faint hum
HANDOFF: the far doors of the library open onto the salon beyond
SEND: frame 0 to image 7 for segment 3
SEND: frame 100 to image 8 for segment 3
SEND: frame 200 to image 9 for segment 3

CHUNK back in the salon
SHOT 10s: push in, slow
The camera passes through the doors and comes back into SALON from the other side: the curved white staircase now rises on the left, the black grand piano stands in the foreground, the green velvet sofa and the tall gilt mirror face the camera across the checkered marble floor, under the crystal chandelier. The camera drifts slowly toward the piano.
SFX: the quiet, large room again; the clock ticking; birdsong

nodes.title: orrery
widgets_values:
## RefMod A/B/C · C late: the RefMods of C from 35 % of sampling on (#27)

Variant **C** adds two RefMods: the place (four stills of the salon from the first chunk, images 3 to 6 → ref_1 to ref_4) and the recent memory (the chunk before, images 7 to 9 → ref_5 to ref_7). Each is built by **Create H3 RefMod From Inputs** (identity_encode, not saved) and applied by its own **Apply H3 RefMod**, one after the other, before Orrery Continue. **ConditioningSetTimestepRange** keeps them out of the first 35 % of sampling, where the layout is decided, and lets them in for the rest, where the detail is (ConditioningCombine joins both halves).

1. Render A's segment 0 first and copy it here: `python experiments/refmod-abc/copy_segment0.py <ComfyUI output folder>`.
2. Set the Orrery Prompt's segment to **1**, then Generate ×3 (segments 1 to 3) into `output/abc_c/`.

The lint "Reference to Video has 0 wired" is expected. Scoring: `experiments/refmod-abc/run_sheet.md`.

widgets_values:
## Models

From [Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3):

- `models/diffusion_models/` [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)
- `models/text_encoders/` [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)
- `models/vae/` [minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors) and [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

Sampling as in ComfyUI's own H3 templates: `res_multistep`, `simple`, 20 steps, no CFG. For a turbo LoRA from the same repository, put a **LoraLoaderModelOnly** after the model loader and lower the steps (4 to 8, as the LoRA says).

**Model Attention Backend** is set to `comfy kitchen attention`: ComfyUI's own quantized INT8 attention, much faster on Nvidia and AMD GPUs. Where it is not available, the node falls back to PyTorch attention by itself (and says so in the log).
